proxy_score: Objective F proxy BFS global WIL in dB for every row, so scores remain comparable across selection objectives. Other objective scores are in proxy_rankings.csv.
dp_objective: Objective responsible for first selecting this geometry; priority-role aliases are in routing_selection_audit.json and top_k.json.
method: First selection role after deduplicating geometries. A geometry may also belong to another method; candidates.json records membership.
wrap_count: Number of fixed edges with an endpoint facing away from its connection, measured from placement before routing; not a count of every incidental A* detour.
median_wil_db: Median over per-permutation exact optimum-assignment WIL.
p90_wil_db: 90th percentile over per-permutation exact optimum-assignment WIL.
p99_wil_db: 99th percentile over per-permutation exact optimum-assignment WIL.
route_success: Existing campaign admission: all edges routed, zero legacy/core DRC and zero bend-radius violations. Spacing/crossing audits retain campaign measurement-only status.
blank_loss_fields: Awaiting Stage 3, or no accepted physical route; never interpreted as zero loss.
improvement_counts: Reference optimum minus candidate optimum greater than 1e-10 dB on the supplied fixed worst sets.
